description: This file manages the display and update of students' answers and marks for specific questions within an online examination system. It handles database interactions to retrieve answers, calculate total marks, and update or delete related database entries based on user actions.

classes.name: ShowAns
classes.description: Code-behind class for the ShowAns ASP.NET page, managing display and submission of student answers and marks.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; retrieves student answers from the database and populates the UI.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Navigates to the admin panel page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Navigates to the admin queue page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Navigates to the admin leaderboard page.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Calculates total marks, updates the database with the new mark, removes the student from the course queue, and redirects.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to login page.
